schedule.desc: Strength. Sweat. Performance. Take your Reformer workout to the next level with Reformer Power—a high-energy, functional Pilates class designed to challenge your strength, stamina, and stability. This is where classical principles meet modern athleticism. Expect powerful, full-body sequences that build lean muscle, elevate your heart rate, and enhance functional movement patterns. Using resistance, tempo, and dynamic flow, Reformer Power is ideal for those wanting a more intense, performance-driven experience. Push past limits. Feel the burn. Unlock your power.
